mechanism.mechanism: Six radial ribs cross-lapped into two slotted hubs
mechanism.retention: Cross-laps constrain twist and height; calibrated friction alone resists radial withdrawal. Optional glue, no positive latch.

assembly.assemblySequence: Hold hubs parallel. Slide rib1 inward, then opposite rib4, then ribs2/5/3/6. Slots are open; no flexing or threading. Reverse to disassemble. Friction-only radial retention.
